# go-modern-time-tick-gc

**Since:** Go 1.23

## Summary

Use time.Tick when it fits; Go 1.23 can recover unreferenced tickers without requiring Stop for GC.

## Details

Go 1.23 made unreferenced tickers recoverable by the garbage collector.
Use time.Tick for simple forever loops, and use time.NewTicker when you need Stop or Reset.

## Examples

### Before

```go
ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
defer ticker.Stop()
for range ticker.C {
  poll()
}
```

### After

```go
for range time.Tick(time.Second) {
  poll()
}
```
